transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. It is very nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, I don't want to sound... well, I just want to be as helpful as possible for you. 

I guess I'm here because of some trouble at work. I do environmental modeling, and... well, I've been noticing some things that are a bit concerning, and I wanted to make sure I'm handling it appropriately. I'm pretty sure the people on our current contract have been tracking my revisions. It actually seems like they're planting errors in the datasets on purpose, just to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. 

I know how that sounds, and I really don't want to be one of those difficult people who blames everyone else. My wife and the junior analysts, they keep telling me it's just standard version-control mistakes. And I always try to listen to them, I really do. I don't want to cause a fuss. But it just feels so targeted. I came here hoping maybe you could tell me if I'm approaching this the right way? I would really value your professional opinion on it, if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling unusually low, or conversely, unusually energized or euphoric, during this same period of time?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I try to keep a pretty even keel, you know? I mean, obviously, the situation with the datasets is a bit stressful, but I'm not... I don't feel depressed. And I'm definitely not, um, overly energized or euphoric or anything like that. Just my regular self, working my normal hours. 

I hope that's helpful? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you can get a clear picture of everything. Am I explaining that okay?
Aside from the concerns about the datasets, have you ever heard or seen things that others could not?

No, I... I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean, I know sometimes people under stress might, um, imagine things, but I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that isn't there. I'm very grounded in reality, I promise. 

I just... I really want to assure you that I'm not... well, I'm not crazy or anything. I just want to be a good employee and make sure I'm doing my job right. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression. I just want to be completely honest with you so you can tell me if I'm handling this work situation correctly.
